new_vendors.price_note: Legals only $350; co-presented ceremony (a friend or relative 'marries' you) $450; tailor-made $850. $150 non-refundable deposit within 7 days, balance 14 days before. Reception MC and long-distance travel are add-ons priced on request.
new_vendors.editorial_summary: Western Sydney celebrant who travels for weddings, vow renewals, baby naming ceremonies and milestone birthdays, and says ceremonies can be classic, modern, multicultural or spiritual. Wedding fees are published in three tiers: legals only, a co-presented ceremony where a friend or relative leads, and a fully tailor-made one. A deposit holds the date and the balance falls due two weeks out. Reception MC and extra travel are priced on request.
